leadText: Toshiyuki Morikawa (Japanese: 森川智之 Morikawa Toshiyuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Toshiyuki Morikawa (Japanese: 森川智之 Morikawa Toshiyuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Morikawa was born on January 26, 1967 in , , . He began his work in the during , playing various roles, one of them being Sabrina's Haunter. Later, he provided the voice of former Hoenn Wallace during . Morikawa is currently affiliated with the talent agency Axlone, and he also formed a band with fellow voice actor Fumihiko Tachiki, called "2HEARTS".
